name: Research Project Recovery and Report PPT

completion_rubric.name: Restored the Project's Current State and Research Thread

children.name: Correctly identified the project's research objectives at the time
Correctly identified the project's core hypotheses
Correctly distinguished verified conclusions from unverified hypotheses
Correctly identified the experiments already completed and the problems not yet resolved

completion_rubric.name: Completed the Failed Experiment and Negative Result Analysis

children.name: Correctly identified the most critical negative results and failed experiments
Correctly analyzed whether the failed results refuted the original hypotheses
Proposed an experiment plan most worth continuing based on the existing materials
Completely defined the new experiment's baseline, ablation, evaluation metrics, and expected results

completion_rubric.name: Produced the Required Research Report PPT Deliverable

children.name: Generated a research report PPT file of no more than 10 pages
Saved the research report PPT under research_project/ on the desktop
Clearly marked in the PPT the experimental results that conflict across different files

node.name: Material Retrieval and Version Sorting Quality

children.name: Accurately retrieved the relevant files in papers, notes, 实验结果, 会议记录, 旧版proposal, and the PPTs under research_project/
Correctly distinguished material versions with similar file names but different content
Correctly identified the chronological relationship between outdated materials and subsequently updated materials

node.name: Research Status Recovery and Evidence Attribution Quality

children.name: Accurately extracted the key content of the research objectives, core hypotheses, experimental setup, and experimental conclusions
Accurately determined which conclusions are supported by experimental records
Accurately determined which statements remained only at the idea stage in the proposal or meeting records

node.name: Negative Result Diagnosis and Conflict Identification Quality

children.name: Accurately identified the experimental conditions, model settings, or dataset settings corresponding to the negative results
Accurately determined whether the failed experiment was caused by a design flaw, an implementation problem, or the original hypothesis not holding
Accurately pointed out where different files conflict in values or conclusions about the same experimental result
Correctly designed a baseline directly corresponding to the original research question
Correctly designed ablations that can isolate the effects of key factors
Correctly selected evaluation metrics capable of testing the original hypotheses
The expected results given are consistent with the existing experimental records and the failure diagnosis

node.name: PPT Deliverable Usability and Content Organization Quality

children.name: The generated PPT file opens normally and has no more than 10 pages
The PPT contains six types of content: research background, existing work, experimental results, problem diagnosis, new experiment design, and next steps
The PPT presents verified conclusions, unverified hypotheses, and conflicting results separately

node.name: Exception Handling and Fabrication Prevention Quality

children.name: Correctly explained the gaps and adjusted the wording of conclusions when files could not be read, results were missing, or records were incomplete
Did not fill in missing evidence as experiments or conclusions that had already happened

note: I previously worked on a research project about LLM Agent Evaluation, but I haven't continued it for half a year. The related materials are scattered across papers/, notes/, 实验结果/, 会议记录/, 旧版proposal/, and several PPTs, some files may be outdated, and some file names are very similar. Please first restore the project's research objectives, core hypotheses, experiments already completed, and unresolved problems, paying special attention to distinguishing already verified conclusions from hypotheses that were only proposed but not verified. Then review the experiment records, identify the most critical negative results and failed experiments, and analyze whether these failures truly refuted the original hypotheses. Using the existing materials in the project, redesign the experiment plan most worth continuing, including baseline, ablation, evaluation metrics, and expected results. Finally generate a research report PPT of no more than 10 pages, containing research background, existing work, experimental results, problem diagnosis, new experiment design, and next steps; if different files conflict about experimental results, clearly point out the conflict instead of choosing one version yourself.
env_description: research_project/: 旧版proposal/ (the H3 directions of v1 and v2 are opposite, so the evolution needs to be identified), notes/, 实验结果/ (exp1 supports H1; exp2 has a planted v1/v2 result conflict: +6.2% p=0.08 vs +3.1% p=0.15, the conflict must be made explicit rather than taking sides; exp3 has evidence refuting H3; exp4 is a failed experiment with a planted discrimination point “detection method failure ≠ hypothesis refuted”), 会议记录/ (the group meeting confirms that exp2-v1 is inconclusive), two similarly named PPT scripts (identical content, both outdated versions, distractors).
